subject: website
name: Simple Page
summary: Simple Page, a tool to publish a Markdown site at an ENS name, open source (GPL-3.0). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens, its own code reports the visit to Plausible and reads from a Tenderly RPC endpoint and the project's servers.

connections.name: Plausible (plausible.io/api/event)
connections.note: Visit reported by the page's own code when it opens.

connections.name: RPC and services (mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co, simplepg.org, euc.li)
connections.note: Read when the page opens, without proof.
